name: fixings
description: Mods that reshape the Claude Code terminal interface, and skills that carry a workflow.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: A pane listing the other Claude Code sessions on this machine, their lanes and what needs you

plugins.name: interview
plugins.description: Interviews you in rounds until every decision is settled, and draws a round row above each question

plugins.name: checkpoint-plan
plugins.description: Stages work into a checkpointed plan, runs it stage by stage or unattended, and draws its progress in the /plan-timeline pane

plugins.name: explainer-page
plugins.description: Builds an interactive HTML explainer page in a fixed house style, and draws its pre-publish checks in a side pane

plugins.name: github-pr-review
plugins.description: Reviews a GitHub pull request into a structured, line-referenced report, and draws the review's progress in the /github-pr-review-panel side panel

plugins.name: what-next
plugins.description: A pane to pick and read what to do next in a project, starting with its docs/proposals, and start a session on one

plugins.name: review-proposals
plugins.description: Assesses all open proposals in docs/proposals together: conflicts, overlaps, order, size, vision drift and clashes with recorded decisions

plugins.name: write-proposal
plugins.description: Writes a proposal into docs/proposals after reading the code and interviewing you on the behaviour you expect

plugins.name: prove-tests
plugins.description: Proves tests are real by breaking the code they guard and checking they fail for the right reason

plugins.name: write-pr-description
plugins.description: Writes a concise, reviewer-focused PR description from session context and git history

plugins.name: checkout-guard
plugins.description: Denies a commit after HEAD left the session's branch, and a branch switch while another session is in the same checkout

plugins.name: evidence-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt showing the last test or build command and the exit status it ended with
